context:
Goal: batch-runner merges under the coordinator's standing grant, and a lane's lease push to its own branch, run with no stop.
Why you: auto mode accepts a settings.json change only on words you type in the acting session. A page answer cannot grant it (decision relayed-grant-read-from-page, the settings exception), so item 352 is replaced by this task.
Departs from: main's autoMode.allow — adds "runner-merge-allow" (batch-runner merges under the coordinator's standing grant) and "Own Branch Lease Push" (a --force-with-lease --force-if-includes push to a branch the session pushed earlier; never --force, -f, +refspec, the default branch, archive/, roadmap, merge-lock, --mirror, --all, or a delete).
Steps: open the first link and type the first line below. Open the second link and type the second line. Then press Done here.

In lane relayed-yes-allow:
go runner-merge-allow: allow batch-runner merges under the coordinator's standing grant

In lane lease-push-c-and-d:
go: add the "Own Branch Lease Push" entry to settings.json autoMode.allow, as drafted in lane lease-push-c-and-d
title: Type two go lines, one in each of two lane chats
why: Each adds one auto-mode allow entry to settings.json. A settings change needs words you type in the acting session's own chat.
